# masterdaweb_instance (Data Source)

Looks up an instance by its id or its name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "masterdaweb_instance" "legacy" {
  name = "legacy-web"
}

output "legacy_ipv4" {
  value = data.masterdaweb_instance.legacy.ipv4_address
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) The instance's id. Give the id or the name.
- `name` (String) The instance's display name, which only it has. Give the id or the name.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When it was created (RFC 3339).
- `custom_image_id` (String) The custom image it was built from, when it was.
- `description` (String) Its note.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Its main disk, in GB.
- `hostname` (String) Its hostname.
- `image` (String) The catalog image it was built or last reinstalled from; null for a custom image.
- `ip_addresses` (Attributes List) Every address of it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ip_addresses))
- `ipv4_address` (String) Its primary public IPv4 address.
- `ipv6_address` (String) Its primary IPv6 address.
- `plan` (String) Its plan's code.
- `power_state` (String) The last power state on record: running or stopped.
- `project_id` (String) The project it is in.
- `ram_mb` (Number) Its memory, in MB.
- `region_id` (String) Its region's id.
- `region_name` (String) Its region's name.
- `subscription_id` (String) The subscription it is billed on.
- `suspended` (Boolean) Whether it is suspended for non-payment.
- `vcpus` (Number) Its vCPUs.
- `vpc_id` (String) The VPC it is on.

<a id="nestedatt--ip_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ip_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) The address.
- `primary` (Boolean) Whether it is the primary address.
- `version` (String) ipv4 or ipv6.
